h: Umahi replies Obi: others did eight years, why should Igbos do only four?
p: Works Minister David Umahi has reportedly responded to remarks by Peter Obi on the Igbo presidential ambition, asking why other zones were allowed eight years while the South-East is told to settle for four. The exchange adds to the argument over zoning ahead of 2027.
more: Umahi has said repeatedly that Tinubu should finish a second term first.
Obi's camp has urged an issue-based campaign.
